title: Microsoft Copilot: realtime voice conversations in Word and PowerPoint
summary: Hold: the briefing incorrectly treats enterprise data protection for Copilot in Word and PowerPoint as unpublished. Microsoft documents that protection across Basic and Premium experiences when users sign in with Microsoft Entra accounts; the roadmap facts and the narrower gaps about this voice feature are otherwise supported.
